logp.method_description: Partition coefficients (Pow), defined as Pow = corg/caq, where corg and caq are the molar concentrations of the selected compound in the n-octanol and aqueous phases, respectively, were determined by the shake-flask method and UV-Vis measurements, according to a previously described procedure.58 All procedures were carried out at 21 ± 1 °C. The wavelength of the maximum absorption of each compound in the 280–360 nm range was used for UV-Vis quantitation. log Pow values are compiled in Table 2.
